title: News
summary: Dated news rows with NEW! badges and category tabs under an oversized watermark — the front page of an official site.

title: Sign in
summary: Email + password with native validation, remember-me, a forgot link and a divider to OAuth — the form every app starts with.

title: Dashboard
summary: Sidebar + toolbar shell with a stats row, a trend chart and recent orders; on a phone the sidebar becomes a strip that scrolls sideways.

title: On Air
summary: Broadcast schedule as a station table, with streaming services below — stacks into label/value rows on a phone.

title: Character
summary: A grid of character cards; each opens a hash-routed modal with the profile and cast. Deep links survive reload.

title: Settings
summary: Profile, notifications and a danger zone as stacked panels in one form — Enter saves, Discard restores — with a sticky save bar.

title: Data page
summary: Breadcrumb, title row with primary action, a status filter and a sortable, searchable, selectable data table whose bulk Remove can be undone.

title: Staff & Cast
summary: Credits as two definition lists side by side — roles in ink labels, names beside them; stacked on a phone.

title: Release
summary: Blu-ray / CD release cards with cover, price, date and a purchase button, soonest first; the grid reflows on phones.

title: Page states
summary: The three non-happy paths every list needs — loading skeleton, empty with a call to action, and error with retry — behind one `state` switch.

title: Pricing
summary: Three tiers with a monthly/yearly switch, a highlighted recommended plan and a feature checklist.

title: Story
summary: Episode list: number, title, air date and a synopsis that expands, under a short premise.

title: Inbox
summary: Two-pane mail: a list with unread indicators and a reading pane whose Archive and Delete can be undone. Collapses to one pane on a phone with a back button.

title: Full site
summary: All six official-site sections inside BlessStage — sidebar nav with scroll-spy, key-visual background, drawer on phones. Opens full-page.

title: Chat
summary: A conversation thread that sticks to the bottom, with a composer that sends on Enter (never mid-IME conversion) and a typing indicator.

title: Onboarding
summary: Three-step first-run wizard — workspace name, invite teammates, pick a palette — with a progress header and a finish screen.
